visualLocks.face: Warm brown skin, brown eyes with dark kohl, serious uncovered face; gold/turquoise circlet with central turquoise teardrop, turquoise/gold drop earrings. Tiny iris and bead shapes limited by pixel source.
visualLocks.hair: Shoulder-length textured black braids/locks swept back, several small gold rings and thin gold ties; no long smooth hair or crown/horns.
visualLocks.costume: Full draped ivory linen wrap dress, chest-to-waist continuously covered, diagonal front wrap, open split skirt, long blue central gold-embroidered panel. Broad blue-and-gold beaded collar, gold/brown waist belt with turquoise buckle and leather pouches/scroll case at anatomicalLEFT hip, blue/gold upper-arm bands and bracers, brown flat strap sandals with gold/turquoise fittings. No crop top, no bare midriff, no boots.
visualLocks.anatomy: Ordinary human head/body, two arms/two legs, natural hands, source proportions maintained; unknown age is not converted to an invented adult age.
visualLocks.equipment: One long gold/bronze khopesh with curved sickle blade and turquoise hilt inset in anatomicalRIGHT hand. Cyan projected balance with central upright, two pans, heart and feather projected above anatomicalLEFT palm. No staff or second sword.
visualLocks.universe: Original Kemet/Douat, solar barque immobilized and names/cartouches threatened by erasure; Tribunal of Two Truths, balance Maat/Isfet, golden grid stone, black-gold temple silhouettes, turquoise spirit light, purple eclipse skies. New settings are original consistent compositions, not official images.
visualLocks.age: Not specified: unknown-family-safe-only and no-romance; keep source apparent proportions. CG15 firstStep at same age, CG13 explicit WhatIf gender swap.
